title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
abstract: Open-source 7B-parameter VLA trained on 970K episodes from Open X-Embodiment. Outperforms RT-2-X (55B) by 16.5% absolute. Fine-tunable via LoRA on consumer GPUs.

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Representation Learning for Visual Imitation
abstract: Non-parametric imitation learning via k-nearest-neighbor lookup in BYOL-learned visual embeddings. No policy training needed -- achieves 80% on seen door opening tasks with Hello Robot Stretch.

title: BC-Z: Zero-Shot Task Generalization with Robotic Imitation Learning
abstract: Large-scale behavioral cloning on 25,877 demos across 100 tasks. Generalizes to 24 unseen tasks at 44% success without task-specific demonstrations.

title: CLIPort: What and Where Pathways for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Combines CLIP semantic understanding with TransporterNet spatial precision for language-conditioned tabletop manipulation across 10+ tasks.

title: Perceiver-Actor: A Multi-Task Transformer for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Perceiver IO transformer on 100^3 voxel grid for multi-task 6-DoF manipulation. Strong inductive bias for 3D enables learning from few demos per task.

title: RVT-2: Learning Precise Manipulation from Few Demonstrations
abstract: Coarse-to-fine multi-view transformer achieving 81.4% on RLBench 18 tasks. Trains 36x faster than PerAct with millimeter-level gripper precision.

title: 3D Diffusion Policy: Generalizable Visuomotor Policy Learning via Simple 3D Representations
abstract: Diffusion policy conditioned on sparse point cloud features. 85% average on 4 real-world dexterous tasks. Strong viewpoint and spatial generalization.

title: Universal Manipulation Interface: In-The-Wild Robot Teaching Without In-The-Wild Robots
abstract: Handheld GoPro grippers with SLAM enable data collection across 30 environments. Policies transfer across UR5 and Franka without retraining. 100% on cup arrangement.

title: What Matters in Language Conditioned Robotic Imitation Learning over Unstructured Data
abstract: Hierarchical language-conditioned policy achieving 82.7% single-task success on CALVIN. Learns multi-task sequential manipulation from unstructured play data.

title: AMP: Adversarial Motion Priors for Stylized Physics-Based Character Control
abstract: Adversarial imitation learning using motion capture as a style discriminator. Produces naturalistic gaits without manual reward engineering. Widely extended to real robots.

title: DreamWaQ: Learning Robust Quadrupedal Locomotion With Implicit Terrain Imagination
abstract: Proprioception-only quadruped locomotion with implicit terrain imagination. 95% survival in push-recovery. Validated on 430m outdoor rough terrain course.

title: Transporter Networks: Rearranging the Visual World for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: Infers spatial displacements for pick-and-place via cross-correlation. Extreme sample efficiency -- learns from as few as 10 demos. Foundation for CLIPort.

title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
abstract: LLM-generated code composes 3D voxel value maps for MPC-based manipulation. 88% real-world success on 5 tasks. Zero-shot to novel objects and instructions.

title: Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation with Pretrained Image-Editing Diffusion Models
abstract: Finetunes InstructPix2Pix on robot video for visual subgoal generation. Low-level diffusion policy executes toward subgoals. Outperforms RT-2-X on WidowX tasks.

title: LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning
abstract: 130 manipulation tasks organized into 4 suites for studying lifelong robot learning. Controlled distribution shifts across spatial, object, and goal dimensions.
